Jordan: Heads-up: MagnetIQ just spun up two new teams (support-assistant + recs) under one org and we saw a combined inference + embedding uptick ~4x this morning. Likely an expansion signal. @Priya can you triage? :rotating_light:
Priya: Which projects? Any tags in the traffic?
Jordan: org:magnetiq, projects: support-assistant, recs-index. Theyre doing streaming convo gen for support and hourly embedding syncs for recs.
Evan: Got a note from their lead: "Launch pilot this week, expect initial 60k embeddings/day and 3k gen reqs/hr during peak working hours. Need p95 <500ms for gen ops."
Katherine: 60k/day embeddings + streaming gen is non-trivial. Do they want a dedicated SLA or are they exploring?
AE-Ravi: They signaled they're evaluating premium SLAs as part of renewal conversation in ~3 months. This feature is tied to ARR impact.
capacity-bot: auto-allocated +3 concurrent workers to hosted-pool-7 for org:magnetiq (policy: short-burst).
Priya: Quick perf probe: gen p50 ~140ms, p95 ~630ms under current load. Embedding pipeline p95 ~340ms. With +3 workers gen p95 drops to ~280ms.
Evan: Note from their infra: mixed markdown + code blocks causing tokenization variance; some docs balloon token counts. Theyre also using 15s streaming windows.
Katherine: Action items: @Priya run sustained 3hr perf and collect p50/p95; @Evan prepare tokenization sniff script & sample transform tips; @AE-Ravi draft a short pilot pricing (7-14 day reserved pod) and outline Dedicated pilot path.
Priya: Suggested quick batch tuning for embeddings: ```batch_size=200, concurrency=5, prefix_cache=on``` plus enable streaming chunking for gens (4s chunks).
AE-Ravi: I'll aim to have pilot quote + customer success play by EOD. Recommend AE join tomorrow sync.
Jordan: This is a strong expansion signal. Marking ticket as "expansion_lead" and flag for CS leadership review. Also recommend an enablement session for their infra and product teams.
Priya: I'll upload perf traces and include a short checklist for tokenization and chunking.
Evan: Scheduling 30-min enablement for tomorrow 9:30am PT.
Jordan: Thanks team. Follow up in CS sync Monday. :calendar:
